name: lispan_chem_v1
description: Phase 3b v1: the Li-SPAN PINN conditioned on the C-rate (0.1-1 C) and four chemistry inputs - dU0_2, dU0_3 (offsets of the step-2/3 equilibrium potentials relative to step 1, +-0.12 V), b (common multiplier of the OCV slopes, 0.6-1.5) and k0_1 (step-1 rate constant, x0.1-x10); common U0 shift, contact resistance and sulfur fraction are analytic (chem_pinn.py). Window and evaluation cases from configs/lispan_chem_design_v1.json (644 FV discharges at Z_CC = 0.010 Ohm m2; quartic window fit, max error 0.9 %, held-out max 2.2 %, so the window stops at 97 % of the fitted cut-off). Training recipe from Phase 3a waves 3-4 (no weight guard; rollback with the best-recent-level baseline from step 0, at most 10 per 20 000 steps - wave 4 without early rollbacks lost the wide and seed-2 runs to collapses at 11-20k; adaptive weights frozen at 60 000; best.pt on the select cases) with the Phase 3a collocation points (1536/1024/192) and 150 000 steps: ~0.53 s per step on the sandbox (the Phase 3a model: 0.49 s there, 0.54 s on Grace), so ~25 h per run on one Grace core.
